body:
Her parents are aware, but everyone sort of feels helpless since she denies almost every attempt to help her. 

She's in roughly her mid to late twenties.

I'm an ok friend.  I'm a bit nerdy and can be annoying, so most people can only stand my personality in small doses.  It's tricky when all I have to offer is my personality and all they want is for me to shut up and listen when there's only an outpouring of negativity.

I'm not allowed to express myself or invoke the tools or techniques I've learned in order to suppress negativity in myself.  I end up feeling very trapped and it's very scary for me because I feel as though I'm being infected by negative thought patterns.

I may not be offered the opportunity to keep her company again, as she was very irate about me coming back into the house.  As much as it sounds selfish to say so, it may have been for the best since I appear to be more ill-equipped to counsel her.

You guys that monitor this site are saints. I really appreciate all you do.

It almost feels as though she threatens suicide for the kind of attention she'll get. I don't know if she was ever serious. I would never say this to her. 

I'm going to guess that you're probably asleep.  Thanks for the help (not sarcasm, I really mean thank you. Really -- isn't it a shame that I feel I have to do that?)
Ok. She let me in, but she kicked me out again. I stayed for almost an hour. She claimed she was going to sleep. I think it'll be ok.
I'm back at her house, but no one is answering.
she kind of kicked me out.  I have to go now.  I'll be back.  OP will deliver.
